{"metadata":{"description":"The complete collection of Kiro IDE configs, agents, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations for maximum productivity.","id":"gh:1139909532","install_available":false,"language":null,"name":"everything-kiro","slug":"iamaanahmad/everything-kiro","topics":["ai-agents","amazon-kiro","developer-tools","dsh-plugin","kiro","kiro-agent","kiro-dev","kiro-ide","llm","mcp"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"The complete collection of Kiro IDE configs, agents, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations for maximum"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ollection of Kiro IDE configs, agents, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations for maximum productivity."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Everything Kiro"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**A collection of Kiro IDE configurations — agents, hooks, steering files, powers, and skills — kept"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" in sync with Kiro's actual current schemas.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## What's Inside"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Key Concepts (as they actually work today)"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Steering files"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Markdown files in `.kiro/steering/` (workspace) or `~/.kiro/steering/` (user), loaded based on front"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"n files in `.kiro/steering/` (workspace) or `~/.kiro/steering/` (user), loaded based on frontmatter:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"`manual` steering files show up as slash commands (`/filename`). This replaced the old "manual hook "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"trigger" concept entirely."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### AGENTS.md"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Place an `AGENTS.md` file anywhere in your workspace to give Kiro directory-scoped instructions — co"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"nventions, restrictions, stack details. A root-level `AGENTS.md` applies workspace-wide; nested ones"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" narrow scope to their subtree. Instructions merge from parent to child; more specific files win on "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"conflicts. Added in **IDE 1.0.309**."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"See `examples/AGENTS.md` for root, API-layer, and infra examples."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Hooks"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Hooks are versioned JSON files at `.kiro/hooks/*.json` (workspace) or `~/.kiro/hooks/*.json` (user):"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Triggers: `SessionStart`, `Stop`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PreTaskExec`, `P"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ostTaskExec`, `PostFileCreate`, `PostFileSave`, `PostFileDelete`. `PreToolUse`, `UserPromptSubmit`, "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"and `PreTaskExec` can **block** — a command action exiting with code 2 stops the operation. See `hoo"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ks/README.md` for the full reference."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Global (user-level) hooks apply across every workspace. Added in **IDE 1.0.182**."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Hooks also fire on **agent-driven file changes** (not just user saves). Added in **IDE 1.0.116**."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Permissions"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"A capability-based system that controls what the agent can read, write, execute, and call. Replaces "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"the old Trusted Commands / Command Denylist from 0.x. Rules live in YAML files:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- `~/.kiro/settings/permissions.yaml` — user scope, all projects
- `~/.kiro/workspace-roots/<hash>/p"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ermissions.yaml` — workspace scope, one project"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Workspace permissions are stored *outside* the repo (per-user) so a cloned repo cannot inject rules."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Capabilities: `fs_read`, `fs_write`, `shell`, `web_fetch`, `web_search`, `mcp`, `subagent`, `skill`,"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" `power`. Priority: `deny > ask > allow`. See `examples/permissions.yaml` for a full annotated refer"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"er`. Priority: `deny > ask > allow`. See `examples/permissions.yaml` for a full annotated reference."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Custom Agents (IDE 1.0 format)"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Agents are Markdown files in `.kiro/agents/` (workspace) or `~/.kiro/agents/` (user). The IDE 1.0 fo"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"rmat adds `tools` tags, inline `permissions`, `welcomeMessage`, and more in the frontmatter:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Short-form `tools` tags: `read` = `fs_read`, `write` = `fs_write`, `shell`, `web` = web tools, `*` ="},{"id":"p30s2","text":" all built-in tools. Switch agents mid-session without losing conversation history. The 8 agents in "},{"id":"p30s3","text":"this repo each have an appropriate tools scope."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### Specs"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Kiro's structured feature workflow: three gated files under `.kiro/specs/{feature_name}/`."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"1. **requirements.md** — EARS-format acceptance criteria (`WHEN [event] THEN [system] SHALL [respons"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"e]`)
2. **design.md** — architecture, interfaces, data models
3. **tasks.md** — checkbox list of cod"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"gn.md** — architecture, interfaces, data models
3. **tasks.md** — checkbox list of coding-only tasks"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Each phase requires explicit user approval before the next begins. **Quick Spec** mode generates all"},{"id":"p34s2","text":" three in one pass for smaller features. See `skills/development-workflows/spec-driven-development.m"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"d` and `examples/example-spec/`."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"### Powers"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Powers package documentation (and optionally an MCP server) into something Kiro activates on demand:"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- **Knowledge Base Power** — `POWER.md` only (`development-power`, `devops-power`)
- **Guided MCP Po"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"wer** — `POWER.md` + `mcp.json` (`database-power`)"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Powers can also be packaged in the open **Agent Plugin format** (bundled skills + MCP), installable "},{"id":"p38s2","text":"from a local folder or GitHub URL. Added in **IDE 1.0.288**."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"No `power.json` — all metadata lives in `POWER.md` frontmatter. See `powers/README.md` and the offic"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"ial Powers registry."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"### Agent Focus Mode"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"An experimental chat-first layout for directing multiple parallel agent sessions. Launch independent"},{"id":"p41s2","text":" sessions, watch file changes as inline diffs, and use structured workflows (Spec, Plan, Bug Fix, Qu"},{"id":"p41s3","text":"ick Spec) or freeform chat. Toggle from the top-right corner. Added in **IDE 1.0**; Cloud Sessions i"},{"id":"p41s4","text":"n Agent Focus added in **IDE 1.0.293**."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"### Cloud Sessions"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"Run a session in the cloud alongside local ones. Start from Agent Focus Mode, pick the repositories "},{"id":"p43s2","text":"it works against, and keep working after closing your laptop. Added in **IDE 1.0.293**."},{"id":"p44s1","text":"### Cloud Configuration Sync"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"Steering files, custom agents, skills, powers, and hooks can be synced to your Kiro account and acce"},{"id":"p45s2","text":"ssed across the IDE and Agent Focus. Cloud-managed items show a cloud indicator and open as read-onl"},{"id":"p45s3","text":"y with an "Edit in web" action. Added in **IDE 1.0.437**."},{"id":"p46s1","text":"### MCP"},{"id":"p47s1","text":"External tool servers configured in `.kiro/settings/mcp.json` (workspace) or `~/.kiro/settings/mcp.j"},{"id":"p47s2","text":"son` (user). Supports the latest MCP protocol revision including OAuth for servers that require sign"},{"id":"p47s3","text":"-in. Keep enabled servers to what a project actually needs — every enabled MCP server's tools count "},{"id":"p47s4","text":"against context budget."},{"id":"p48s1","text":"### Kiro Crew"},{"id":"p49s1","text":"Kiro Crew runs on Kiro CLI and reads existing `.kiro` configuration. This repository's steering, hoo"},{"id":"p49s2","text":"ks, skills, and custom-agent patterns carry over after installation without a separate migration."},{"id":"p50s1","text":"This is compatibility documentation only: Everything Kiro does **not** ship a Crew manifest, schedul"},{"id":"p50s2","text":"es, Apps, integrations, or autonomous orchestration workflows."},{"id":"p51s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p52s1","text":"See INSTALL.md for the full walkthrough. Short version:"},{"id":"p53s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p54s1","text":"Then edit `.kiro/settings/mcp.json` and replace the placeholder tokens with real credentials — never"},{"id":"p54s2","text":" commit real secrets."},{"id":"p55s1","text":"## Contributing"},{"id":"p56s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
